FlashVSRNode.description: Single-node FlashVSR video upscaling with VRAM-aware processing.

frames.name: Frames
frames.tooltip: Input video frames as an IMAGE batch (N, H, W, C).

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: FlashVSR model version. V1.1 is recommended for stability.

mode.name: Mode
mode.tooltip: Processing mode: tiny is faster, tiny-long is optimized for long videos, and full prioritizes quality.

vae_model.name: VAE Model
vae_model.tooltip: Full-mode decoder: Wan2.1 for highest fidelity or LightVAE_W2.1 for lower VRAM. Official Wan2.2 uses incompatible 48-channel latents. Tiny modes use TCDecoder.

color_fix.name: Color Fix
color_fix.tooltip: Match decoded colors to the input using the selected correction method.

fix_method.name: Color Fix Method
fix_method.tooltip: Wavelet is the default and preserves generated high-frequency detail; AdaIN matches per-frame color statistics.

tiled_vae.name: Tiled VAE
tiled_vae.tooltip: Use the Full Wan VAE's native tiler to reduce decode VRAM. Tiny modes ignore this option.

tiled_dit.name: Tiled DiT (Deprecated)
tiled_dit.tooltip: Kept for workflow compatibility and ignored at runtime because independent DiT tiles reduce quality.

unload_dit.name: Unload DiT
unload_dit.tooltip: Unload the DiT before VAE decoding to free VRAM.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed used for reproducible noise generation.

frame_chunk_size.name: Frame Chunk Size
frame_chunk_size.tooltip: External stateless frame chunking is disabled for quality; nonzero values are ignored. Use tiny-long for stateful long-video processing.

attention_mode.name: Attention Backend
attention_mode.tooltip: Auto prefers a mask-capable backend. Dense Sage/FlashAttention choices accelerate compatible calls; masked self-attention keeps the model topology through masked SDPA when needed.

enable_debug.name: Debug Logging
enable_debug.tooltip: Enable detailed progress, timing, and VRAM logging.

keep_models_on_cpu.name: Keep Models on CPU
keep_models_on_cpu.tooltip: Keep inactive models in CPU RAM to reduce VRAM pressure.

resize_factor.name: Resize Factor
resize_factor.tooltip: Keep at 1.0 for full quality. Lower values discard source detail before super-resolution.

0.name: Image
0.tooltip: Upscaled video frames as an IMAGE batch.

local_range.name: Local Range
local_range.tooltip: 11 matches the reference ComfyUI node and favors temporal stability; 9 is sharper. Default: 11.
